sample_description: concretion (mineralized matrix) in an anterior, bacteria-free calcium body of the terrestrial isopod Hyloniscus riparius; dissected in absolute ethanol or methanol, air dried, under a cover slip on a glass slide
conditions: T=ambient; P=ambient; FT-Raman (Bruker Ramanscope III, LN2-cooled Ge detector), ~100 mW at sample, 40x LWD objective, 4 cm-1 nominal resolution
mode_description: external lattice mode: translation of CO3 groups against Ca
notes: paper: calcite lattice vibration (155 and 280); similar spectra in intermolt and intramolt stages; authors note the CaCO3 may be amorphous in vivo and could have crystallized under laser heating
